enabled.description: Enable or disable the ejabberd_mod_filter module globally.

external_script.description: Absolute path to an optional external script for custom packet filtering logic. Leave empty to use built-in ACL-based rules only.

rules.description: List of packet filtering rules. Each rule defines how to handle matching packets using access control or custom filters.

name.description: Unique identifier for this rule (used as a key). Should be descriptive and unique.

type.description: Rule type: 'access' uses ejabberd's built-in access rules; 'filter' allows custom filter expressions (e.g., regex on stanza content).

access.description: Name of an ejabberd 'access' rule (defined elsewhere in ejabberd.yml) to apply when this rule matches. Required if type='access'.

filter.description: A filter expression (e.g., regex, predicate) for custom filtering logic. Required if type='filter'.
